# Examining clustering

```{r, fig.width = 21, fig.asp = 1/3}

    plot_umap(color_str = "RNA_snn_res.0.1", label = TRUE) 
p2 <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.5") %>% 
    mutate(RNA_snn_res.0.5 = factor(RNA_snn_res.0.5, levels = 0:17)) %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", label = TRUE) 
p3 <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.9") %>%  
    mutate(RNA_snn_res.0.5 = factor(RNA_snn_res.0.9, levels = 0:24)) %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "RNA_snn_res.0.9", label = TRUE) 
plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3)
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
markers_wide <- markers_df %>% get_wide_tbl_from_markers()
write_csv(markers_wide, file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_markers05wide.csv"))
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
markers_readable <- markers_df %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.01) %>% 
    filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
    group_by(cluster) %>% 
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = rank, 
                names_from = cluster, 
                values_from = gene) %>% 
    dplyr::select(rank, as.character(0:17))
write_csv(markers_readable, file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_markers05readable.csv"))
```

# Assign clusters

```{r}
cluster_ann_df <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds") %>% 
    filter(clustering == "RNA_snn_res.0.5") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))

cluster_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)
cluster_grouped_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_grouped %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)

palette_cluster <- cluster_ann_df$color %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name)

cluster_ID_name_ordered <- cluster_ann_df %>% 
    arrange(cluster_ID_grouped) %>% 
    .$cluster_ID_name
```

```{r}
cell_type_metadata <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", reduction = NULL) %>%
    mutate(clusters = cluster_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
    mutate(general_cell_types = cluster_grouped_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
    select(-RNA_snn_res.0.5) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = cell_type_metadata)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "clusters") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "clusters", label = TRUE) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = palette_cluster)
get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "general_cell_types") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "general_cell_types", label = TRUE) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Marker dot plot

```{r}
genes <- c(
    "Pmel", "Mlana", # Tumor
    "Klre1", "Klra7", "Klrd1", # NK
    "Mki67", "Stmn1", "Top2a", # prolif, 
    "Cd3d", "Trbc2", "Trac", "Cd8a", # T cell
    "Col4a1", # EC
    "Col3a1", # Fibroblasts
    "Siglech", # pDCs 
    "S100a9", "S100a8", # Neutrophils
    "Irf8", # Irf8 high DCs
    "Ccr7", "Fscn1", # Migratory DCs
    "Cd209a", "H2-Ab1", # Monocytic DCs
    "Wfdc17", # M2a macs
    "Ccl12", "C1qa", "C1qb", # M1/M2b macs
    "Mmp12", "Arg1", # MDSC
    "Chil3", "Il1b", # Monocyte/Neuts
    "Igkc", "Jchain" # B cells
)

# learned a new way to add color to axis tick labels in https://datavizpyr.com/add-colors-to-axis-tick-label-in-ggplot2/
dotplot_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = "clusters",
                         genes = genes,
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.),
                 names_to = "gene",
                 values_to = "expr") %>%
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes)) %>% 
    group_by(gene) %>%
    mutate(scaled_expr = as.vector(scale(expr))) %>%
    group_by(clusters, gene) %>%
    summarise(mean_scaled_expr = mean(expr)) %>%
    mutate(
        color = palette_cluster[as.character(clusters)], 
        name = glue::glue("<i style='color:{color}'>{clusters}</i>")
    ) %>% 
    mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, as.integer(clusters)))
dotplot_df %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(gene, name) +
    geom_point(aes(size = mean_scaled_expr, color = mean_scaled_expr)) + 
    labs(caption = "color and size are scaled mean expression; cell types not shown in any particular order here") + 
    scale_color_viridis() + 
    remove_spines() + 
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(color = "black"), 
          axis.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), 
          axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
```

# cluster representation in samples

## stacked bar plots

```{r, fig.asp = 2, fig.width = 3}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    group_by(clusters, group) %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters, group) %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(group, prop, fill = clusters) + 
    geom_col() + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), 
          legend.position = "none")
```

```{r, fig.asp = 2, fig.width = 3}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    group_by(clusters, mouse) %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters, mouse) %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(mouse, prop, fill = clusters) + 
    geom_col() + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust =0.5), 
          legend.position = "none")
```

## Bar plots with stats

```{r}
group_mouse_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "group"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    select(mouse, group) %>% unique()
prop_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "general_cell_types"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    filter(!(general_cell_types %in% c("Tumor", "Stromal"))) %>%
    calculate_proportion(general_cell_types, mouse) %>%
    left_join(group_mouse_df, by = "mouse")
prop_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(group, prop) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_point() +
    labs(y = "Proportion of Immune cells", 
         caption = "P-values from t tests") +
    stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = prop_df$group %>% unique() %>% combn(m = 2, simplify = F),
        label = "p.signif",
        method = "t.test"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ general_cell_types, scale = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ~ c(0, .[2] * 1.1),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    remove_x_spine() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
    ))
```

# Analysis

## CD40 expression by cell type

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Cd40") %>% 
    plot_violin(clusters, Cd40) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) + 
    labs(y = "Gene Expression", title = "Cd40", subtitle = "All cells")
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Cd40") %>% 
    filter(group == "Ctrl__Isotype") %>% 
    plot_violin(clusters, Cd40) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) + 
    labs(y = "Gene Expression", title = "Cd40", subtitle = "WT Isotype only")
```

# UMAPs of Markers

```{r}
t_cell_genes <- c("Ptprc", "Cd3e", "Cd8a", "Cd4", "Trdc", "Foxp3", "Ikzf2", "Nkg7")
t_cell_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = t_cell_genes, metadata = NULL)
t_cell_df %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(t_cell_genes), names_to = "gene") %>% 
    named_group_split(gene) %>% 
    imap(~plot_umap(..1, color_str = "value") + labs(color = ..2) + 
             theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 8))) %>% 
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 3, align = "hv")
```
